card.fact_statement: Typhoon Kong-rey was the largest storm to strike Taiwan since Typhoon Herb in 1996.
card.answer: largest storm to strike since Typhoon Herb
card.source_span: and the largest storm to strike since Typhoon Herb in 1996.
